mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reviews (order_item_id, product_id, account_id, rating, comment) VALUES ( #{orderItemId}, #{productId}, #{accountId}, #{rating}, #{comment} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, product_id AS productId, account_id AS accountId, rating, comment, created_at AS createdAt FROM reviews WHERE product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT id, product_id AS productId, account_id AS accountId, order_item_id AS orderItemId, rating, comment, edit_count AS editCount, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM reviews WHERE id = #{reviewId}
mapper.update: UPDATE reviews SET rating = #{rating}, comment = #{comment}, edit_count = edit_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS review_id, r.order_item_id, r.rating, r.comment, r.edit_count, r.created_at, p.id AS product_id, p.name AS product_name FROM reviews r INNER JOIN products p ON r.product_id = p.id WHERE r.account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
